intro: This tab calculates the color correction. Hold both color cards where the subject will be: the app detects them on its own and takes a still image. Check the corner points and drag them into place if needed. The color correction is then calculated automatically, and again whenever the corner points change.
referenceActive: Reference values: {name} ({count} patches). You can switch or import the set in the ⚙ menu at the top right.
idle: Hold both color cards steady where the subject will be. The size in the image does not matter.

wipe.divider: Wipe slider: camera colors on the left, corrected on the right
